proposals.headline: trialta__blur_crush::vectorize: palette is gone, geometry survived
proposals.rationale: palette_fidelity=0.003, ink_iou=0.2638. The shape is recoverable and the colour is not, so this is a colour-recovery problem. Do not invent a brand colour from grey — that is already a recorded lesson.
proposals.decision_reason: Acting now. Restoring washed colours in the reconstruction path: chroma restored along the sketch's own hue for coloured elements, lightness for neutrals, and never a hue invented from grey — honouring the recorded lesson this proposal cites.

proposals.headline: Bisect the regression on swift_orange_solid__import_combo::vectorize
proposals.rationale: Dropped 0.0173 (0.9465 -> 0.9292). It passed before, so the change that broke it is in recent history.
proposals.decision_reason: False premise: nothing to bisect. 142001Z was a reconstruction run (old gate) recorded as if it were the shipping path; the shipping path still scores 0.9292 exactly as on 09-19. The drop is real only inside the reconstruction path: the derived gate (195782e) keeps the trace when one exists and gave up 0.9465 here. Fixed by ranking candidates on craftsmanship (task #7 / Swift rebuild), not by bisecting. Runs now record LOGO_IDEALIZE and are compared only like with like.
